map.明渠均匀流计算工具基于曼宁公式（Manning's Equation），用于计算: The open-channel uniform flow tool uses Manning equation to compute flow and velocity for trapezoidal channels under steady uniform flow. Input bottom width, depth, side slope, bed slope, and roughness to get flow area, hydraulic radius, wetted perimeter, Froude number, and flow-regime classification.
